::: {.product-interpretation}
Mean precipitation per wet day is calculated from days with at least 0.04 inch in the latest 90 days and ranked against 1991-2020 periods ending within two calendar days of this date. High ranks mean unusually heavy wet days and low ranks mean unusually light wet days; cells with no qualifying wet days are blank.
:::
